typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExecutionBatchID as integer (),
	ExternalFactoryCode as integer (),
	MaxUID as integer (),
	ProfilSSIS as string (),
	RMData as string (),
	pDestination as string (),
	pExtFactoryCode as integer (),
	pSource as string (),
	pStage as string ()
}

source(output(
		{External Factory Code} as integer,
		LIBETAB as string,
		{Code Formula} as string,
		NUMORDRE as string,
		NUMOPTIM as string,
		LIBFRML as string,
		{CREATED DATE} as timestamp,
		COMMENT as string,
		WorkflowStatus as integer,
		Available as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  CAST(q1.[External Factory Code] as int) [External Factory Code],  [LIBETAB],  RTRIM(CAST(q1.[Code Formula] as NVARCHAR(20))) as "Code Formula", CAST(RTRIM([NUMORDRE]) as  NVARCHAR(20)) as NUMORDRE,  CAST(RTRIM([NUMOPTIM])  as  NVARCHAR(20))  as NUMOPTIM,  q1.[LIBFRML],  q1.[CREATED DATE],  [COMMENT],  1 as WorkflowStatus,  1 as Available   FROM [dbo].[ARDM_FORMULA_INFORMATION] q1  INNER JOIN (SELECT [Code Formula], [External Factory Code], MAX([CREATED DATE]) as "Created Date" FROM [dbo].[ARDM_FORMULA_INFORMATION] GROUP BY [Code Formula], [External Factory Code]) q2 ON q1.[Code Formula]=q2.[Code Formula] and q1.[External Factory Code]=q2.[External Factory Code] and q1.[CREATED DATE]=q2.[CREATED DATE]    WHERE q1.[External Factory Code]= ?   ORDER BY q1.[External Factory Code] desc',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceOLEDB	source(output(
		FormulaCode as string,
		VersionCode as string,
		RevisionCode as string,
		UIDFactory as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  RTRIM(FormulaCode) as FormulaCode,  RTRIM(VersionCode) as VersionCode,  RTRIM(RevisionCode) as RevisionCode,  UIDFactory   FROM ProcessCardFormulasVersions',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> RechercheLKPTABLE
SourceOLEDB derive(UserName = ProfilSSIS,
		Comment_crit = COMMENT) ~> Colonnedrive
Colonnedrive,RechercheLKPTABLE lookup(NUMOPTIM == RevisionCode && {External Factory Code} == UIDFactory && {Code Formula} == FormulaCode && NUMORDRE == VersionCode,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Recherche
Recherche split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> RechercheIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
RechercheIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		COMMENT as string,
		{Code Formula} as string,
		NUMORDRE as string,
		NUMOPTIM as string,
		{External Factory Code} as integer,
		Comment_crit as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		COMMENT = Param_0,
		{Code Formula} = Param_1,
		NUMORDRE = Param_2,
		NUMOPTIM = Param_3,
		{External Factory Code} = Param_4,
		Comment_crit = Param_5)) ~> CommandeOLEDB
RechercheIsMatch@NotMatch derive() ~> PlaceHolderScriptComponent
PlaceHolderScriptComponent sink(input(
		UID as integer,
		{Code Formula} as string,
		{CREATED DATE} as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		UserName as string,
		NUMORDRE as string,
		NUMOPTIM as string,
		{External Factory Code} as integer,
		COMMENT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		UID = Param_0,
		{Code Formula} = Param_1,
		{CREATED DATE} = Param_6,
		UserName = Param_7,
		NUMORDRE = Param_2,
		NUMOPTIM = Param_3,
		{External Factory Code} = Param_4,
		COMMENT = Param_5)) ~> CommandeOLEDB1
